messages:
leo (oncall): incident-bot: canary rollout 0.3 started ~3m ago. seeing 2.7% 5xx on /v1/stream, healthcheck failures on canary hosts (hc-lb-*)
incident-bot: ALERT: canary_health_rate >= 2% for 120s
nina (eng): yep seeing tails of streaming backend OOM in logs, stack points at encoder v2.2. suspect regression from new buffering change
maya-sre: oncall checking logs, attaching sample:
```text
[svc-stream] 2026-03-15T12:02:11Z ERR write: connection reset by peer
[svc-stream] encoder: buffer overflow, drop
```
leo (oncall): abort criteria in rollout is 2% 5xx for 2m -> that's hit. I'm flipping abort flag now
leo (oncall): `/flag rollback=canary-0.3 abort=true` -> done
deploy-bot: FLAG UPDATE: rollback=canary-0.3 set to abort=true by leo (oncall)
sam-deploy: confirming traffic shift back to 0.2, initiating canary rollback
nina (eng): can we hold on full rollback? maybe smaller mitigation: disable encode-buffer optimization via feature flag `encode-buffer-v2=false`
cristina (pm): we have a handful of paying customers streaming right now — what's customer impact? any timeouts?
maya-sre: customer-facing errors: ~0.8% requests receiving 500 with body 'stream closed'; retries may succeed but latency spikes; small set of ~10 high-traffic sessions affected
leo (oncall): priority: rollback to ensure safety. sam, roll forward / roll back timeline?
sam-deploy: starting rollback job id: `rb-3123456789-1`
opsbot: rolling back canary group `cg-17` to image 0.2, ETA ~2m
nina (eng): grabbing heap profiles from canary nodes, uploading to s3://redwood-dumps/canary/3123456789
leo (oncall): paging replacements: nina you're primary triage, maya you own postmortem and customer comms. cristina pls gather impacted account list
nina (eng): investigating root cause: encoder v2 retains chunks when stream aborted; fix likely in two-line guard in encoder. will PR after rollback
deploy-bot: rollback complete, traffic at 100% stable on 0.2
incident-bot: RESOLVED_THRESHOLD met: 5xx rate back under 0.5% for 180s
cristina (pm): customer list: acct-849, acct-453, acct-112 flagged for outreach
leo (oncall): handing off to maya for next shift. mia (oncall-2) will take next 2h
maya-sre: taking over, will coordinate postmortem draft and customer notes. adding to #incidents
leo (oncall): adding follow-ups: add synthetic canary test for encoder regressions, lower abort threshold for streaming endpoints to 1.5%, add extra capacity to streaming pool
maya-sre: ack, starting postmortem template. will include timeline, mitigation steps, RCA, action items
leo (oncall): thanks all :thumbsup:
